description: Stop a background job that is still queued or running, as the Cancel button of the notification centre does: a report, a test category sort, an exploration, a test generation. Whatever it already finished is kept. Stop test runs with stop_runs instead. Returns the job with its status; one that had already finished is returned as it is.

job.description: The job's id, as list_jobs shows it.
